mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lms.tb_curriculum ( room, term, man_count, start_date, end_date, cur_name, account_seq, business_name, reg_id, reg_date, status ) VALUES ( #{room}, #{term, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{manCount, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{curName}, #{accountSeq, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{businessName}, #{regId}, NOW(), #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE lms.tb_curriculum SET room = #{room}, term = #{term, jdbcType=INTEGER}, man_count = #{manCount, jdbcType=INTEGER}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, cur_name = #{curName}, account_seq = #{accountSeq, jdbcType=INTEGER}, business_name = #{businessName}, update_id = #{updateId}, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE cur_seq = #{curSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, (SELECT account_name FROM lms.tb_account WHERE account_seq = c.account_seq) AS teacherName FROM lms.tb_curriculum c WHERE cur_seq = #{curSeq}
mapper.update: UPDATE lms.tb_curriculum SET status = 'D', update_date = NOW() WHERE cur_seq = #{curSeq}
